evidence_basis: Actual original ELF trio main/ld-linux/libc SHA256 and source sizes pinned and verified before guest execution.
Original SHA-verified upstream full FEX Linux ARM64 ELF from earlier successful CI run; this is not embedded FEXCore Android runtime.
A guest x86-64 DSO loaded using original GNU ld-linux --preload constructor, BEFORE original guest main() and after ld-linux relocations.
Source ELF DT_RELA and all three R_X86_64_RELATIVE slots were independently read from the original on-disk main ELF source and independently checked against live main PIE load bias+source addend.
All three observed runtime relocated qwords differ from file-backed source values, proving nontrivial original main relocation state.
Real original guest libc puts import runs after the relocation witness with expected stdout.
Two separate original full FEX Linux AArch64 dynamic-loader processes succeeded and a source-original no-witness negative control emitted only the original puts marker.
GitHub logs show exit-zero functional gate plus exact ordered markers; artifact contains stdout/stderr, rc and machine-readable runtime proof.
limitations: Actual guest GNU dynamic linker internal relocator loop is not directly traced; post-relocation live ELF qwords before main are verified. This is strong original GNU ld-linux full-runtime relocation outcome evidence.
No original GNU ld-linux relocation implementation was run in embedded standalone FEXCore on Android/Bionic.
No guest TLS/TCB/DTV/FS was proven for the Android custom runtime.
No Wine/Proton or Windows PE graphics/game execution.
